title: Prawn Salad with Mediterranean Kiss
description: A fresh and flavorful salad featuring succulent prawns, mixed greens, and a zesty Mediterranean kiss.

ingredients.name: Kissed vinegar
ingredients.notes: Olive oil and lemon juice mixture

ingredients.name: Salad
ingredients.notes: Chopped cucumber, bell peppers, and/or cherry tomatoes

instructions: 1. Rinse the prawns under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
2. In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, chopped cucumber, bell peppers, and/or cherry tomatoes.
3. In a small bowl, whisk together Mediterranean kiss and kissed vinegar.
4. Add the whisked vinaigrette to the bowl with the greens and toss to combine.
5. Add the prawns to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
8. Just before serving, sprinkle with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or mint.
